entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a helmet. Order number is 774-B-91. Can you process that for me?
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's a preference. The color is wrong. It was a gift, and the box is still unopened. It's a simple return, yes or no?
Okay, thank you for that information. I'm pulling up your order now... I see it was delivered 83 days ago.
Right. So can I return it?

Yes, absolutely. Our policy allows for returns on standard items up to 90 days. Since you're within that window, I can process this for you right away. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear, especially when it comes to safety.
Great. That's all I needed. What's next?
I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on file. Simply print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
